system.description:
When targeted by an attack you may roll 1 Skill Die. On a Luck symbol the attacker is Cursed and has Minor Disadvantage on its next Combat Turn, and you add +1 Talent Die to every Skill Check you make on your next Combat Turn.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.58

when.label: During your next Combat Turn after a Luck Drain success

automation.note: When targeted by an attack, roll 1 Skill Die (/r 1ds). On a Luck symbol, target the attacker and click Use to Curse it; it also has Minor Disadvantage (-1 Skill Die) on its next Combat Turn. Tick the +1 Talent Die on your checks during your next Combat Turn.
